run_FollowBallManualPolicy: run the FollowBallManualPolicy function to simulate a minitaur following a ball in the gym environment
create_MinitaurBallGymEnv: create a MinitaurBallGymEnv instance with render, pd_control_enabled, and on_rack parameters
run_env_step: run env.step with a tanh-based action derived from the observation to advance the simulation
run_env_reset: run env.reset to initialize the gym environment and get the initial observation
run_main: run the main entry point to execute the minitaur ball following example script
